info.name: Tradeshift External Dx Category Documents Document API

params.name: tag
params.description: The tag the document must have. Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as OR unless you set useAndOperatorForTags to true, then it will be AND.

params.name: useAndOperatorForTags
params.description: It sets the tags based search to meet all criteria within the set of provided filters.

params.name: withouttag
params.description: The tag the document must not have. Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as AND.

params.name: propertykey
params.description: Must be specified together with propertyvalue. Each pair of propertykey and propertyvalue will be interpreted as AND by default unless you set useOrOperatorForProperties to true, then it will be OR.

params.name: propertyvalue
params.description: See propertykey.

params.name: useOrOperatorForProperties
params.description: It sets the property based search to meet at least one criteria within the set of provided filters.

params.name: ascending
params.description: Whether the documents are ordered in ascending or descending order (for last edited date), defaults to descending.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of documents to include. Examples of document types 'invoice', 'creditnote'. Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as OR.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page to return. Each page has 'limit' number of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. This is also the number of results on each skipped page. Capped to 100. If _onlyIndex is set to true, includesourcedocuments and populatePersonInfo to false value is capped to 10000.

params.name: id
params.description: The documents to get DocumentInformation for (a Tradeshift UUID value)

params.name: businessId
params.description: Limits documents to those with the given business id (invoice/credit note/purchase order number, e.g. 'ABC-123'). Note that business ids are not guaranteed to be unique for received documents, and may potentially be duplicated for different documents, even sent by the same supplier.

params.name: sentBy
params.description: Sender company tenant id (a Tradeshift UUID value).

params.name: sentTo
params.description: Receiver company tenant ids (a Tradeshift UUID value).

params.name: stag
params.description: The system tag the document must have. Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as OR. Known system include "inbox", "outbox", "draft", "sales", "purchases", "deleted".

params.name: minissuedate
params.description: Earliest issue date of documents to match (according to UBL content).

params.name: maxissuedate
params.description: Latest issue date of documents to match (according to UBL content).

params.name: since
params.description: Limits documents to those which have changed since the given timestamp, formatted as a XSD-timestamp.

params.name: createdBefore
params.description: Limits documents to those which were created before the given timestamp, formatted as a XSD-timestamp.

params.name: createdAfter
params.description: Limits documents to those which were created after the given timestamp, formatted as a XSD-timestamp.

params.name: processState
params.description: The _user_ state the document must have (see /metadata). Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as OR. Note that this parameter is misnamed as it searches among all user states, not just process state.

params.name: withoutProcessState
params.description: The process state the document must not have (see /metadata). Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as AND. Note that this parameter is misnamed as it searches among all user states, not just process state.

params.name: branchId
params.description: Document business ids. Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as OR.

params.name: totals
params.description: Whether to calculate the documents total amount or not.

params.name: state
params.description:
Representing the state (e.g. SENT, DELIVERED, ACCEPTED) of the searched documents.
Can be used multiple times, which is interpreted as OR.
Accepted values are: UNDETERMINED, IN_TRANSIT, PENDING_NOT_A_CONTACT, FAILED_DELIVERY, SENT, DELIVERED, ACCEPTED, OVERDUE, PAID_UNCONFIRMED, PAID_CONFIRMED, REJECTED_BY_SENDER, REJECTED_BY_RECEIVER, DISPUTED_BY_RECEIVER, CLOSED, REPLACED, CORRECTED, IN_ENRICHMENT, IN_CLEARANCE, COLLECTED, AWAITING_ASSISTANCE, ASSISTANCE_PROVIDED, CANCELED, ASSISTANCE_CANCELED, PUNCHOUT_SENT, PUNCHOUT_EDIT.

params.name: ordering
params.description: Field that indicates the criteria on which result will be ordered upon returning (e.g. DueDate, Amount, Date).

params.name: sales
params.description: This parameter decides whether the transaction type of selected documents should be sale or not.

params.name: query
params.description:
This parameter defines the specific text to be searched within the documents. It can include a single or
multiple words or phrases and documents that match the search condition will be returned.

params.name: copyIndicator
params.description: Whether to search only copies of documents, originals or both.

params.name: onlycopies
params.description: Whether to search only copies of documents.

params.name: onlydrafts
params.description: Whether to search only drafts.

params.name: onlydeleted
params.description: Whether to search only deleted documents.

params.name: includesourcedocuments
params.description: Whether to include the raw UBL document in the result. The UBL documents are stripped of attachments before they are returned.

params.name: waitForIndex
params.description: Whether to wait for pending documents to be indexed.

params.name: _onlyIndex
params.description: This flag allows document listing using exclusively the data from the index.

params.name: conversationId
params.description: The document conversation id used for getting its related documents.

params.name: totalFrom
params.description: It represents the minimum value of the total range that can be used to filter documents.

params.name: totalTo
params.description: It represents the maximum value of the total range that can be used to filter documents.

params.name: currency
params.description: It represents the currency that can be used to filter documents only of that currency.

params.name: requesterId
params.description: This field can be used to filter documents by the given list of requester Ids, only applicable for Purchase Request Documents. The requester is either the creating person or the document or if specified the "on behalf of" person

params.name: invoiceTypeCode
params.description: This field represents the type of invoice for an invoice document. If the field is missing then we will have a normal/commercial invoice filter. For value 325 proforma invoice type will be searched and for value 386 we will have prepayment invoice.

params.name: accountingSystemId
params.description: This field represents a custom value assigned by a client to a connection with a supplier.

params.name: accountingCost
params.description: This field represents a custom value assigned by a client refering to a Cost Center.

params.name: profileId
params.description: It represents the profile id of a given document.

params.name: populatePersonInfo
params.description: Populate person info (actor and requester)

params.name: orderTypeCode
params.description: This field represents the type of order for an order document.

params.name: orderChangeTypeCode
params.description: This field represents the type of order for an order change document.

items.docs: Gets a list of documents for the current user in XML or JSON format depending on the request Accept header. If multiple criteria are specified, they act as logical AND, unless specified otherwise. Drafts are not returned by default, unless stag=draft is specified. The return list of documents can be sorted by DueDate, LastEdit, Number, Amount, Date, Type.

params.name: owningCompanyId
params.description: UUID identifier of company account owning the document.

params.name: documentId
params.description: Document UUID identifier

items.docs:
Retrieves a document in the context of an owning company. If the supplied authentication context has access to
see document identified by {documentId}, meaning the sender of the document, then returns a redirect to GET the document with {documentId}.
If the supplied authentication context does not have access to the document, then checks to see if it has
access to a document that references the supplied {documentId}, and returns a redirect to GET that referencing document instead.

Get a list of the latest dispatch information by object IDs. The returned data contains information like:
the creation time of the dispatch, the dispatch sender, the channel through which the document is dispatched,
the current dispatch state, the ID of the object being dispatched, the connection ID used for dispatching and
technical information containing the reason why a dispatch failed (returned only for failed dispatches).

This endpoint saves the content of a document for cases when a company has received a document outside of the
Tradeshift platform but wants to add it to the document list anyway. It imports a document as if it has been
received at some point in time. It will be visible in the document list, but replies, such as comments, will
not be possible. Only the receiver side copy is created and the original sender will not be notified even if
they are on the platform and they are connected.

profile using documentProfileId (e.g. "tradeshift.invoice.ubl.1.0") and the document profile set between the sender and the receiver.
This can be used before dispatching a document in order to verify if it has profile related errors or not. If the "receiverCompanyId"

Returns the document identified by the given UUID, if it exists and is not marked as deleted.
If you want to retrieve the deleted documents, use [Find Documents](#get-rest-external-documents) along
with stag=deleted parameter and with the corresponding id.
The document can be retrieved in a PDF representation or in one of the raw UBL formats
(XML, JSON or Oasis JSON) depending on the Accept header. The default format is the XML.

params.description:
Parameter that indicates if the document should be created in draft mode or not. Documents such as Order Change, Receipt Advice, Remittance Advice,
Status Messages, Reminder Messages or Assignments can't be created as drafts while documents such as Invoice are partially validated when it is saved as draft.

params.description: The document profile id of the document which will be created (e.g. "tradeshift.requisition.ubl.1.0"), from the 'documentprofiles' resource.

params.name: schemaValidate
params.description:
Parameter that indicates if the document should be validated against the UBL schema. If this parameter is set to TRUE, the API will detect the UBL
version to validate against from the document content. This validation is triggered only if the document is *not* created as draft and also
if the Nemhandel validation is enabled for the specified document profile.

params.name: validateDocumentProfile
params.description:
Parameter that indicates if the document should be validated or not using the selected document profile.
The validation is triggered only if the document is not created as draft.

as the entity/body of the API call. The client can decide on the UUID for the new element defined by the
"documentId" parameter. Saving a document as draft will use the document content as primary source for tradeshift internal

Otherwise, saving it as a non-draft w

items.docs:
Soft delete of the document. Deleting a document using this API will not delete the document from the
system, but mark it as deleted. This operation will only affect user's copy of the document, receiver's
(or sender's) copy will remain intact.
User can still query deleted documents if they wish to do so. More details about how to retrieve deleted
document can be found in [Find Documents](#get-rest-external-documents) section.
It's not recommended to delete a document using given endpoint.

items.docs:
Truncate the content for the given document if any exists. This action cannot be revoked or reverted.
This is to be used if document content must be permanently wiped, for example for privacy reasons. Truncated documents
will have all content except number and issue date removed. All versions of the document will also be truncated
including the document attachments. The document will not be visible in the document manager UI.

These are automatically converted to ubl during the dispatch. The original content is stored and can be retrieved using this endpoint.

Creates an ApplicationResponse to change the state of a document (e.g. accept, reject, dispute).
This endpoint calls a method secured with the UPDATE_DOCUMENT operation, allowing users with roles such as
Accounts Payable Handler to change document state without requiring the CREATE_EDIT_DOCUMENT operation.
Only ApplicationResponse documents (tradeshift.status.1.0 profile) are supported.
The document profile is fixed and does not need to be specified by the caller.
